interpretations.answer: Completing the prep course raised math scores by an estimated 5.618 points [estimate:completed_vs_none.value]. This estimate is based on comparing students who completed the course to those who completed none.
caveats: The design assumes that the decision to take the course, after being offered, is sufficiently captured by the measured covariates (lunch status and parental education level) such that, conditional on these, the decision to take the course is as good as random [design.assumption].
A placebo treatment refuter passed with a p-value of 0.94 [refute:completed_vs_none.placebo_treatment_refuter.passed, refute:completed_vs_none.placebo_treatment_refuter.p_value].
A data subset refuter passed with a p-value of 0.92 [refute:completed_vs_none.data_subset_refuter.passed, refute:completed_vs_none.data_subset_refuter.p_value].
